scope: Non-Tokyo records in the 2026-06-01 MHLW snapshot; public directory website URLs only. URL retrieval screening is not a language-capability verification.
limitations: Missing website URLs were not inferred.
No retrieved page, no matching text, a website translation feature and a blocked request never become a negative language capability.
Site retrieval includes robots-policy preflight. Unavailable preflight means the content was not crawled.
Reported upstream failures do not establish that a facility website is down.
Clinically named languages are not a same-day availability confirmation.
This is not a completed language verification of all facilities.
